event_summary: A folded white card on a black circular base turns while an orange ball in a blue-and-black holder becomes hidden behind it and later partly reappears.
raw_event_description: At the start, a white folded card stands on a black circular base on a wooden table, with an orange textured ball held in a blue-and-black U-shaped holder above it. The white card changes orientation across the view, at times showing a narrow A-shaped profile and later a broad rectangular face. The orange ball and holder move lower in the frame relative to the card and become progressively occluded by the white card. For a long interval, the front white panel hides most or all of the ball and the blue holder, while a black vertical handle or stem remains visible above the card. Later, as the card continues changing orientation, the blue holder and orange ball reappear partially behind the side opening of the folded card, then become more hidden again as the card turns.

reasons: The folded white card, black circular base, orange ball, and blue-and-black holder are visible at the beginning.
The scene objects are already arranged in the event setup at the first frame.
